# Safety Sphere Solution

> Leading Fire Safety, EHS, ESG, Digital Safety, and Industrial Consulting company in India.

## About

Safety Sphere Solution delivers 360° Fire, Environment, Health & Safety (EHS), ESG, Digital Safety, and Industrial Consulting services. We help organizations build safer, smarter, and sustainable workplaces across Power, Oil & Gas, Metro, Rail, Healthcare, Pharma, Infrastructure, Manufacturing, Cement, Steel, Mining, and related sectors.

Primary locations: Nagpur (Maharashtra) and Raipur (Chhattisgarh), serving clients pan-India.

## Core Services

- [Fire Safety Engineering](https://safetyspheresolution.vercel.app/services/fire-safety-engineering): Fire audits, Fire NOC, hydrant/sprinkler/alarm systems, VESDA, foam, CO₂, water mist, design, installation, testing, commissioning, AMC
- [EHS Engineering & Consulting](https://safetyspheresolution.vercel.app/services/ehs-engineering): Environmental compliance, EIA, HAZOP, COSHH, ESG, LOTO, HIRA, JSA, machine guarding, chemical safety
- [Professional EHS Training](https://safetyspheresolution.vercel.app/services/ehs-training): Fire fighting, first aid/CPR, working at height, electrical safety, confined space, BBS, leadership, crane/rigging/scaffold
- [Digital Automation & AI](https://safetyspheresolution.vercel.app/services/digital-ai): AI safety monitoring, IoT safety, digital PTW, digital LOTO, dashboards, AI cameras, ESG intelligence
- [Safety Consultancy & Audits](https://safetyspheresolution.vercel.app/services/safety-consultancy): Fire/electrical/machine guarding audits, ISO consulting, carbon footprint, contractor safety, documentation
